UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Learner profile, XP, level, total stars, and parent-controlled preferences for Pastel Playland.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in family/educator account.

learnerName.description: Child's display nickname shown in the Playland hub.

xp.description: Accumulated experience points toward the Star Progress Meter.

level.description: Current learner level derived from XP.

totalStars.description: Sum of stars earned across Playland mini-games.

soundEnabled.description: Whether tactile audio chimes and spoken phonics cues are enabled.

dailyTimerEnabled.description: Whether the parent-configured daily play timer is active.

dailyLimitMinutes.description: Daily play limit in minutes (10 to 120).

parentPin.description: 4-digit PIN code protecting the Parent & Educator Corner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

GameProgress.title: GameProgress
GameProgress.description: Per-game star rating (0-3), high score, and completion stats for a learner.

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved in this mini-game.

completed.description: True when at least 1 star has been earned.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

StickerReward.title: StickerReward
StickerReward.description: Unlocked collectible sticker reward in the learner's Sticker Book.

stickerId.description: Unique sticker identifier matching the document ID.

title.description: Playful title of the unlocked sticker.

category.description: Learning category associated with the sticker.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on unlock.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores the learner profile, star totals, XP, and parent settings for the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/gameProgress/{gameId}.description: Stores per-game 3-star progress and best scores under the user's subcollection.

/users/{userId}/stickers/{stickerId}.description: Stores unlocked collectible stickers under the user's subcollection.
